verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships a built-in AI assistant, Mercury Command, that users can hand bookkeeping tasks to in plain language. Documented tasks include writing journal entries, organizing the chart of accounts, bulk categorization, bulk GL code assignment and creating categorization rules. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks execute reliably, in-depth docs on Command's task scope, review/approval flow and limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Mercury Command a question about your books, or hand off a bookkeeping task to it directly, in plain language.
Let Command clear the backlog — Offload work like writing journal entries, organizing your chart of accounts, categorization in bulk, and more.
Use Mercury Command to bulk assign GL codes, create categorization rules, and more
